name: Tayho Advanced Materials Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Tayho Advanced Materials Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of high-tech fibers in China. It provides Newstar Spandex, a polyurethane elastic fiber that is used in underwear, socks, tights, sportswear, swimwear, laces, and suits, as well as in medical and hygiene textiles, automotive interiors, etc. The company also provides Newstar Meta Aramid, which is used in personal protection, environmental protection, meta-aramid paper, industrial felt, and other areas.
